quotations.old_english: Smíton on ǽgðer gedyre and on ða ofergedyru
quotations.latin: ponent super utrumque postem et in superliminaribus domorum

source_text: ofer-gedyre, es; n. A lintel :-- Smíton on ǽgðer gedyre and on ða ofergedyru ponent super utrumque postem et in superliminaribus domorum, Ex. 12, 7. v. ofer-dyre.
